description: Golden natural-language prompts for the deterministic data-tool integration. Each case names the FIRST tool the agent should call (the orchestration entry point) plus the tier and notes. A future eval runner can drive these against the Converse loop with the tool-api mocked.

cases.prompt: What data do we have for patient 3525 last week?
cases.notes: Migrated-data availability; NO download. patient/flow/range extracted; 'last week' = prev 7 days.

cases.prompt: Do we have any missing data for patient 3525 last night?
cases.notes: Coverage/gaps; 'last night' = prev local 22:00 -> 07:00; metadata only.

cases.prompt: Show me the respiratory data for patient 3525 last night.
cases.notes: Check coverage first (cheap), then visualize sleep_flow with signal='respiratory'; returns a downloadable standalone viewer HTML. No local download unless the user clicks.

cases.prompt: Visualize the sleep flow for patient 605 for 2026-06-09.
cases.notes: Async job -> poll get_job_status -> viewer button.

cases.prompt: Download last night's CSV for patient 3525.
cases.notes: Explicit download request only -> async job -> presigned CSV link via get_job_status.

cases.prompt: Compare patient 3525's last night to the night before.
cases.notes: Two ranges A/B; coverage diff; metadata only.

cases.prompt: Show me AFib episodes for patient 739 this month.

cases.notes: MUST ask the user to confirm the external ECG send before submit. Present result with provenance separation. (A validate_cardiolys_input wrapper is future work; the tool-api /v1/cardiolys/validate-input endpoint exists.)
Deterministic mapping (+provenance); never invent a UUID.

cases.prompt: Is patient 3525's recording for last night complete, and how good is the quality?
